Which pixels does your classifier actual.zh:
你的分类器究竟使用了哪些像素？四种归因方法（原始梯度、SmoothGrad、
          积分梯度、Grad-CAM）在同一张图像上实时计算。
          它们在何处一致、在何处分歧，以及各自可能“说谎”的已知原因。
Which pixels does your classifier actual.src:
Which pixels does your classifier actually use? Four
          attribution methods (vanilla gradient, SmoothGrad,
          Integrated Gradients, Grad-CAM) computed live on the same
          image. Where they agree, where they disagree, and the
          known reasons each one can lie.

@@T0@@~16 min@@T1@@\n @@T2@@Int.zh:
@@T0@@约 16 分钟@@T1@@
          @@T2@@可解释性 · 显著图 · 视觉@@T3@@

A classifier outputs \"tumor present, p.zh:
分类器在一张扫描图上输出“存在肿瘤，p = 0.92”。
          随之而来的正确问题便是@@T0@@为什么@@T1@@。显著图方法会生成一张
          逐像素的“重要性”图，回答“输入的哪些像素对本次预测影响最大？”。
          它们很有用，有时却极具误导性，而且在发布或部署模型之前，
          几乎总是值得运行一遍。
A classifier outputs \"tumor present, p.src: A classifier outputs "tumor present, p = 0.92" on a scan. The right next question is why. Saliency methods produce a per-pixel "importance" map answering "which pixels of the input most influenced this prediction?". They are useful, sometimes deeply misleading, and almost always worth running before publishing a model or deploying it.

@@T0@@The catch.@@T1@@\n Salien.zh:
@@T0@@其中的陷阱。@@T1@@
          显著图并不等于证据。同一个预测可以由截然不同的图来支持。
          关于显著图与 Shapley 值的实验（Adebayo 等，2018）表明，
          某些方法在随机化模型上也能通过其健全性检验——这意味着
          即便分类器是随机的，生成的图看起来仍与原来相似。
          把显著图用于@@T2@@生成假设@@T3@@，而不是用它来证实假设。
@@T0@@The catch.@@T1@@\n Salien.src: The catch. Saliency does not equal evidence. The same prediction can be supported by very different maps. Saliency-shapley experiments (Adebayo et al., 2018) show some methods pass their sanity tests on randomised models — meaning the map looked like the original even when the classifier was random. Use saliency to generate hypotheses, not to confirm them.

@@T0@@Vanilla gradient.@@T1@@\n.zh:
@@T0@@原始梯度。@@T1@@
            $\partial f_c / \partial x$。代价最低，噪声最大。
            在 ReLU 上会饱和（当单元处于关闭状态时梯度为零）。
@@T0@@Vanilla gradient.@@T1@@\n.src: Vanilla gradient. $\partial f_c / \partial x$. Cheapest, noisiest. Saturates on ReLUs (zero gradient where the unit was off).

@@T0@@SmoothGrad.@@T1@@ Average vanilla.zh:
@@T0@@SmoothGrad。@@T1@@ 对图像的 $n$ 个加噪副本
            上的原始梯度求平均。更平滑、更稳定；
            但仍对模型敏感。
@@T0@@SmoothGrad.@@T1@@ Average vanilla.src: SmoothGrad. Average vanilla gradients over $n$ noisy copies of the image. Smoother, more stable; still sensitive to the model.

@@T0@@Integrated Gradients.@@T1@@ Integr.zh:
@@T0@@积分梯度。@@T1@@ 沿一条从基线（常取零）
            到输入的路径对梯度做积分。它满足@@T2@@完备性@@T3@@：
            各像素的归因之和等于（输出 − 基线输出）。
@@T0@@Integrated Gradients.@@T1@@ Integr.src: Integrated Gradients. Integrate gradients along a path from a baseline (often zeros) to the input. Satisfies completeness: pixel attributions sum to (output − baseline-output).

@@T0@@Grad-CAM.@@T1@@ Gradient-weighted.zh:
@@T0@@Grad-CAM。@@T1@@ 在选定的卷积层上计算
            梯度加权的激活图。粒度更粗（每个 CNN 单元对应一个像素），
            但忠实于网络内部的特征空间。
@@T0@@Grad-CAM.@@T1@@ Gradient-weighted.src: Grad-CAM. Gradient-weighted activation map at a chosen conv layer. Coarser (one-pixel-per-CNN-cell) but faithful to the network's internal feature space.

For Integrated Gradients, $x^\\prime$ is.zh:
对积分梯度而言，$x^\prime$ 是基线（常为黑色图像）。
          该积分保证了@@T0@@完备性@@T1@@：
          $\sum_i \mathrm{IG}_i = f_c(x) - f_c(x^\prime)$——预测的每一个单位
          都被归因到@@T2@@某个@@T3@@像素上。任何没有积分路径的梯度方法
          都不具备这一性质。
For Integrated Gradients, $x^\\prime$ is.src: For Integrated Gradients, $x^\prime$ is the baseline (often a black image). The integral guarantees completeness: $\sum_i \mathrm{IG}_i = f_c(x) - f_c(x^\prime)$ — every unit of the prediction is attributed to some pixel. No gradient method without an integration path has this property.

Axioms — why we should care about them.zh: 公理——我们为何应当关注它们
Axioms — why we should care about them.src: Axioms — why we should care about them

Sundararajan, Taly, Yan (2017) introduce.zh: Sundararajan、Taly、Yan（2017）提出了一个用于评估归因方法的公理化框架。四条关键公理为：
Sundararajan, Taly, Yan (2017) introduce.src: Sundararajan, Taly, Yan (2017) introduced an axiomatic frame for evaluating attribution methods. The four key axioms:

@@T0@@Sensitivity.@@T1@@ If $x$ and $x^\.zh:
@@T0@@敏感性。@@T1@@ 若 $x$ 与 $x^\prime$ 在单个特征上不同并给出不同的预测，
            则该特征必须获得非零归因。原始梯度因 ReLU 饱和而@@T2@@不满足@@T3@@
            这一公理；IG 则满足。
@@T0@@Sensitivity.@@T1@@ If $x$ and $x^\.src: Sensitivity. If $x$ and $x^\prime$ differ on a single feature and give different predictions, that feature must get non-zero attribution. Vanilla gradient fails this because of ReLU saturation; IG satisfies it.

@@T0@@Implementation invariance.@@T1@@ T.zh:
@@T0@@实现不变性。@@T1@@ 两个功能上完全相同的网络应当给出相同的归因。
            原始梯度满足；而某些在激活处保持梯度流的方法（DeepLIFT、LRP）
            在病态情形下可能不满足。
@@T0@@Implementation invariance.@@T1@@ T.src: Implementation invariance. Two functionally-identical networks should yield identical attributions. Vanilla gradient passes; some methods that hold gradient flow at activations (DeepLIFT, LRP) can fail in pathological cases.

@@T0@@Completeness.@@T1@@ Attributions s.zh:
@@T0@@完备性。@@T1@@ 各归因之和等于预测值减去基线值。
            只有路径积分方法（IG、Shapley 值）满足这一性质。
@@T0@@Completeness.@@T1@@ Attributions s.src: Completeness. Attributions sum to the prediction minus the baseline. Only path-integrated methods (IG, Shapley values) satisfy this.

@@T0@@Linearity.@@T1@@ Attribution of $\.zh:
@@T0@@线性性。@@T1@@ $\alpha f + \beta g$ 的归因等于 $\alpha$ × $f$ 的归因
            + $\beta$ × $g$ 的归因。所有关于梯度线性的方法都满足。
@@T0@@Linearity.@@T1@@ Attribution of $\.src: Linearity. Attribution of $\alpha f + \beta g$ equals $\alpha$ × attribution of $f$ + $\beta$ × attribution of $g$. Satisfied by all linear-in-gradient methods.

The axioms uniquely pick out the path-in.zh:
当你同时要求 Shapley 式的对称性时，这些公理会唯一地选出路径积分梯度。
          这正是为什么在代价可承受时，积分梯度（及其 Shapley 类亲属，如 Expected Gradients）
          是学术上正确的选择。
The axioms uniquely pick out the path-in.src: The axioms uniquely pick out the path-integrated gradient when you also require Shapley-style symmetry. That's why Integrated Gradients (and its Shapley relatives, like Expected Gradients) are the academically-correct choice when you can afford them.

Live, on a synthetic image.zh: 在合成图像上实时演示

Below: a hand-crafted small CNN (just 1.zh:
下面：一个手工构造的小型 CNN（仅含 1 个卷积层 + 全局平均
          + 线性头，权重为人工选定）对一张合成“热成像”图像进行分类。
          切换图像，观察四种显著图随之变化。图像中的高温区域
          即为真实信号；一个忠实的方法应把其归因聚焦在那里。
Below: a hand-crafted small CNN (just 1.src:
Below: a hand-crafted small CNN (just 1 conv + global mean
          + linear head, with manually-chosen weights) classifies a
          synthetic "thermal" image. Toggle the image and watch the
          four saliency maps respond. The hot regions in the image
          are the ground-truth signal; a faithful method should focus
          its attribution there.

@@T0@@Vanilla gradient is noisy.@@T1@@ S.zh:
@@T0@@原始梯度的噪声很大。@@T1@@ 单像素的差异
            会使结果散乱；网络中的微小非线性占据主导。
            SmoothGrad 与 IG 通常更易解读。
@@T0@@Vanilla gradient is noisy.@@T1@@ S.src: Vanilla gradient is noisy. Single-pixel differences scatter; tiny network non-linearities dominate. SmoothGrad and IG are usually more readable.

@@T0@@IG depends on the baseline.@@T1@@.zh:
@@T0@@IG 依赖于基线。@@T1@@ 黑色图像并不总是
            恰当的“特征缺失”。对热成像而言，
            使用恒定温度作为参照更为诚实。
@@T0@@IG depends on the baseline.@@T1@@.src: IG depends on the baseline. Black image isn't always the right "absence of feature". For thermal, a constant-temperature reference is more honest.

@@T0@@Grad-CAM is class-discriminative @.zh:
@@T0@@Grad-CAM 的类别判别性@@T1@@按层@@T2@@而异。@@T3@@
            选错层就会得到一团均匀的斑块。
            按惯例应使用最后一个卷积层。
@@T0@@Grad-CAM is class-discriminative @.src: Grad-CAM is class-discriminative per layer. Pick the wrong layer and you get a uniform blob. Conventionally use the last conv layer.

@@T0@@None of these is causal.@@T1@@ Sal.zh:
@@T0@@这些方法都不是因果性的。@@T1@@ 显著图是
            “$f$ 在 $x$ 处的梯度”，而不是“若移除该像素会发生什么”。
            若需要因果归因，请考察
            @@T2@@遮挡法@@T3@@、@@T4@@RISE@@T5@@，或
            @@T6@@基于扰动@@T7@@的方法。
@@T0@@None of these is causal.@@T1@@ Sal.src: None of these is causal. Saliency is "the gradient of $f$ at $x$", not "what would happen if we removed this pixel". For causal attributions look at occlusion, RISE, or perturbation-based methods.

@@T0@@Adebayo's sanity check.@@T1@@ Perm.zh:
@@T0@@Adebayo 的健全性检验。@@T1@@ 置换模型
            的最后一层；重新运行显著图。若所得图看起来没有变化，
            说明你的显著图读的是输入，而非模型。
@@T0@@Adebayo's sanity check.@@T1@@ Perm.src: Adebayo's sanity check. Permute the model's last layer; rerun saliency. If the maps look the same, your saliency is reading the input, not the model.

@@T0@@Final takeaway.@@T1@@\n A.zh:
@@T0@@最终要点。@@T1@@
          在论文插图中，始终把显著图与预测结果并排展示。
          把使用具有领域意义基线的 IG 与 Grad-CAM 结合使用——
          它们以不同的方式失效，而它们之间的分歧本身就富有信息。
@@T0@@Final takeaway.@@T1@@\n A.src: Final takeaway. Always show a saliency map next to the prediction in paper figures. Use IG with a domain-meaningful baseline + Grad-CAM together — they fail in different ways and their disagreement is informative.

Beyond gradient-based: perturbation meth.zh: 超越梯度方法：扰动方法

Gradient methods answer \"if I changed t.zh:
梯度方法回答的是“若我无穷小地改变这个像素，预测会如何变化？”。
          扰动方法则提出更强、更具因果性的问题：“若我@@T0@@彻底@@T1@@移除这个像素，
          预测会如何变化？”。共有三族方法：
Gradient methods answer \"if I changed t.src: Gradient methods answer "if I changed this pixel infinitesimally, how would the prediction change?". A perturbation method asks the stronger, causal question: "if I removed this pixel entirely, how would the prediction change?". Three families:

@@T0@@Occlusion (sliding window).@@T1@@.zh: @@T0@@遮挡法（滑动窗口）。@@T1@@ 用基线（灰色块、模糊）替换每个区域，并测量 $f_c$ 的下降量。速度慢（$O(\text{像素数} \times \text{前向次数})$），但与模型无关；可用于黑盒 API。
@@T0@@Occlusion (sliding window).@@T1@@.src: Occlusion (sliding window). Replace each region with a baseline (gray patch, blur) and measure the drop in $f_c$. Slow ($O(\text{pixels} \times \text{forward passes})$) but model-agnostic; works on black-box APIs.

@@T0@@RISE@@T1@@ (Petsiuk et&nbsp;al., 2.zh:
@@T0@@RISE@@T1@@（Petsiuk et al.，2018）。对输入进行多次随机掩码，
            以所得的 $f_c$ 为每个掩码加权，再求平均。这是一种蒙特卡洛扰动方法，
            既比遮挡法更快，又比 IG 噪声更大。
@@T0@@RISE@@T1@@ (Petsiuk et&nbsp;al., 2.src: RISE (Petsiuk et al., 2018). Randomly mask the input many times, weight each mask by the resulting $f_c$, average. A Monte-Carlo perturbation method that's both faster than occlusion and noisier than IG.

@@T0@@LIME / KernelSHAP.@@T1@@ Fit a spa.zh:
@@T0@@LIME / KernelSHAP。@@T1@@ 对模型在 $x$ 附近扰动上的行为
            拟合一个稀疏线性替代模型。KernelSHAP 还额外强制满足 Shapley 值的性质。
@@T0@@LIME / KernelSHAP.@@T1@@ Fit a spa.src: LIME / KernelSHAP. Fit a sparse linear surrogate to the model's behaviour on perturbations near $x$. KernelSHAP additionally enforces Shapley-value properties.

@@T0@@Causal interpretations.@@T1@@ If y.zh:
@@T0@@因果解释。@@T1@@ 若你想要真正的反事实推理
            （“若该特征缺失，预测是否会不同？”），请参见 @@T2@@概念瓶颈一文@@T3@@——
            对显式概念进行干预，更接近人们通常所说的“为什么”。
@@T0@@Causal interpretations.@@T1@@ If y.src: Causal interpretations. If you want true counterfactual reasoning ("would the prediction be different had this feature been absent?"), look at the concept bottleneck article — intervention on an explicit concept is closer to what people usually mean by "why".

Sanity checks you should always run.zh: 你应当始终运行的健全性检验
Sanity checks you should always run.src: Sanity checks you should always run

@@T0@@Adebayo's randomisation test.@@T1@.zh:
@@T0@@Adebayo 的随机化检验。@@T1@@ 逐层随机化模型的参数。
            若显著图没有变化，说明你的图读的是输入而非模型——
            你得到的只是一个花哨的边缘检测器，而非解释。
@@T0@@Adebayo's randomisation test.@@T1@.src: Adebayo's randomisation test. Randomise the model's parameters layer-by-layer. If the saliency map doesn't change, your map is reading the input, not the model — you have a fancy edge detector, not an explanation.

@@T0@@Data randomisation.@@T1@@ Train tw.zh:
@@T0@@数据随机化。@@T1@@ 训练两个模型，其中一个使用打乱的标签。
            在标签被打乱的模型上，显著图应当在定性上有所不同。
@@T0@@Data randomisation.@@T1@@ Train tw.src: Data randomisation. Train two models, one with shuffled labels. Saliency on the shuffled-label model should be qualitatively different.

@@T0@@Sensitivity-N / pointing game.@@T1.zh:
@@T0@@Sensitivity-N / 指向博弈。@@T1@@ 按归因大小遮蔽前 K 个像素；
            测量预测的下降幅度。在整个数据集上求平均。
            在同一模型上比较各方法。
@@T0@@Sensitivity-N / pointing game.@@T1.src: Sensitivity-N / pointing game. Mask the top-K pixels by attribution; measure prediction drop. Average over a dataset. Compare methods on the same model.

@@T0@@Pixel-flipping / insertion-deletio.zh:
@@T0@@像素翻转 / 插入-删除 AUC。@@T1@@ 按归因从大到小插入像素；
            绘制 $f_c$ 随插入比例变化的曲线；其曲线下面积是一项定量的质量指标
            （Petsiuk et al.，2018）。
@@T0@@Pixel-flipping / insertion-deletio.src: Pixel-flipping / insertion-deletion AUC. Insert pixels by descending attribution; plot $f_c$ vs fraction inserted; the area-under-curve is a quantitative quality measure (Petsiuk et al., 2018).

Saliency for vision transformers.zh: 视觉 Transformer 的显著图

ViTs don't have convolutional feature ma.zh: ViT 没有卷积特征图，因此 Grad-CAM 无法直接适用。有三种替代方案：
ViTs don't have convolutional feature ma.src: ViTs don't have convolutional feature maps, so Grad-CAM doesn't apply directly. Three replacements:

@@T0@@Attention rollout.@@T1@@ Multiply.zh:
@@T0@@注意力回滚。@@T1@@ 跨层相乘注意力矩阵（含残差）。
            粒度粗但无需参数；参见 @@T2@@ViT 一文@@T3@@。
@@T0@@Attention rollout.@@T1@@ Multiply.src: Attention rollout. Multiply attention matrices across layers (with residual). Coarse but parameter-free; see the ViT article.

@@T0@@Attribution rollout@@T1@@ (Chefer.zh:
@@T0@@归因回滚@@T1@@（Chefer et al.，2021）。把注意力与梯度结合；
            在多数基准上优于原始回滚。
@@T0@@Attribution rollout@@T1@@ (Chefer.src: Attribution rollout (Chefer et al., 2021). Combine attention with gradients; outperforms vanilla rollout on most benchmarks.

@@T0@@Token-level IG.@@T1@@ Integrate gr.zh:
@@T0@@词元级 IG。@@T1@@ 对词元嵌入而非像素求梯度积分。
            天然的归因粒度 = 每个图像块一个数值。
@@T0@@Token-level IG.@@T1@@ Integrate gr.src: Token-level IG. Integrate gradients with respect to token embeddings instead of pixels. Native attribution scale = one number per patch.

@@T0@@Simonyan, Vedaldi, Zisserman (2014.zh: @@T0@@Simonyan, Vedaldi, Zisserman (2014)@@T1@@ — @@T2@@《Deep Inside Convolutional Networks: Visualising Image Classification Models and Saliency Maps》@@T3@@。开山之作。
@@T0@@Simonyan, Vedaldi, Zisserman (2014.src: Simonyan, Vedaldi, Zisserman (2014) — Deep Inside Convolutional Networks: Visualising Image Classification Models and Saliency Maps. The original.

@@T0@@Sundararajan, Taly, Yan (2017)@@T1.zh: @@T0@@Sundararajan, Taly, Yan (2017)@@T1@@ — @@T2@@《Axiomatic Attribution for Deep Networks》@@T3@@。IG 的论文。
@@T0@@Sundararajan, Taly, Yan (2017)@@T1.src: Sundararajan, Taly, Yan (2017) — Axiomatic Attribution for Deep Networks. The IG paper.

@@T0@@Chefer, Gur, Wolf (2021)@@T1@@ &md.zh: @@T0@@Chefer, Gur, Wolf (2021)@@T1@@ — @@T2@@《Transformer Interpretability Beyond Attention Visualization》@@T3@@。
@@T0@@Chefer, Gur, Wolf (2021)@@T1@@ &md.src: Chefer, Gur, Wolf (2021) — Transformer Interpretability Beyond Attention Visualization.

meta.title: 显著图：并排比较
meta.tagline: 你的分类器究竟使用了哪些像素？四种归因方法，同一张图像
meta.summary: 在一张带有隐藏真实信号的合成“热成像场景”上，一个手工构造的分类器给出预测。原始梯度、SmoothGrad、积分梯度与 Grad-CAM 实时并排计算显著图。观察它们在何处一致、何处分歧，以及各自可能“说谎”的众所周知的原因。
highlights: 同一张图像上的四张显著图：原始梯度、SmoothGrad、IG、Grad-CAM。
切换合成图像（单个高温斑块 / 两个斑块 / 条纹图案），观察各图随之更新。
每种方法为何可能“说谎”——具体的失效模式（饱和、梯度噪声、定位粗糙）。
与实验对齐：面向 ApneaEye / JoulesEye 解释的热成像归因。
